note: Dubuque County Conservation park on Mud Lake, a Mississippi backwater of Pool 11, six miles north of Dubuque off Hwy 52. 42 camper sites with electric and water (1-26 at 30 A, 27-42 at 50 A in a gravel pull-through herringbone), three tent sites, accessible showers and dump station in the middle of the campground. Sites 7-10 are grass and posted not recommended for Class A motorhomes. Boat ramp, fishing pier, marina and grill next door; ranger in residence year-round. Water and showers are shut off roughly Nov 1 to May 1. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $30, water hookups, showers, dump, ~30% reservable on mycountyparks. Added 50 A (27-42; 1-26 are 30 A), 42 camper sites with pull-throughs, flush toilets, potable water, wifi, the 4-day booking lead and the 14-night limit. Note cleaned. Not waterfront stands. Pin OK.
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands. The county map and Esri imagery agree. The 50 A herringbone (27-42) sits ~55 m from the weed-covered backwater marsh to the south and ~130 m from the open channel to the east, with a dense tree and brush belt between. Sites 1-26 line the west road along Golf Lake Road and the rail line; the north end (sites 14-15, tent 43-45) is ~150 m from the water past the boat-launch parking lot (day use). No sightline to water from any pad. The water faced is Mud Lake / the Pool 11 backwater, not the main Mississippi channel.

SEASON not written: the county posts park hours 'April through November' and 'Water and modern shower/restroom facilities are closed approximately from November 1st through May 1st', but no camping season. A ranger lives on site year-round. Leave season unset; the old note's 'Open April-November' was dropped.
FIT: sites 7-10 are 110-ft grass back-ins flagged 'NOT RECOMMENDED FOR CLASS A MOTOR-HOMES' (weight), a Class A warning only. The other camper sites are 50-80 ft gravel. A 23-ft Class C fits.
PARTY RULE: the contract says 'A camping party consists of no more than four (4) person(s) or is your immediate family of dependent children', a normal county rule.

Phone 563-556-6745 confirmed (park page and Google). Website mycountyparks park page OK; the county map PDF is https://www.dubuquecountyiowa.gov/DocumentCenter/View/7501. Google 4.5 stars / 128 reviews. Pin 42.61696,-90.70370 sits beside the herringbone loop, OK.
